attempts.sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
WHERE s.qualname LIKE 'httpx._client.Client.%'
  AND s.kind = 'method'
  AND s.file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = '_client')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.headings h
    WHERE h.file_id = s.file_id
      AND h.heading = s.name
  )
ORDER BY s.symbol_id;
